sessions.title: Zoë Kravitz and Channing Tatum’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The director of Blink Twice is joined by the film’s star in sharing their love for John Cassavetes and Gena Rowlands, praising Paris Is Burning as “the greatest documentary of all time,” and selecting favorites, from Harlan County USA and The Fisher King to Moonstruck and The Rose.
